technicalNotes: Most 1995 and earlier Bosch ECU's will show you a DTC "00513 - Engine Speed Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G28): No Signal" if you scan them when the engine is not running.   This fault code goes away by itself once you start the engine.   If this sensor were truly defective, the engine would not run at all!   Please ignore this code.
